About Fumbo Ai Ltd

An Accra company building AI that belongs here

Fumbo Ai builds AI chatbots and automations for teams whose customers already live on WhatsApp, web, and social—not in a contact form.

Channels

Focus

Chatbots + automation

Why the name

In Swahili, fumbo means a riddle. We kept the name because the hard part is never the model—it’s the reply, the language, and the handoff that make someone trust you.

Help businesses in Ghana and similar markets answer at scale without sounding like a template, and without burying staff in the same ten questions every day.

Based in Accra. Designed around how people here actually message, speak, and get things done.

Explore services→

Why teams work with us

Not a generic bot with a Ghana sticker on it. Software shaped around the channels, languages, and operations you already have.

01

WhatsApp is the front door

In Ghana, messaging often beats a website form. We treat WhatsApp as a primary channel—then keep the same quality on web, social, and email.

02

Localization is the work

Tone, language, and context are designed into the first flow. Not translated onto a generic English bot after the fact.

03

Handoff without the dead end

Routine questions get answered. Anything that needs judgment goes to your team with the thread intact.

04

Wired into your stack

Chat is only useful if it can check an order, open a ticket, or update a CRM. We connect the conversation to the system of record.

05

Pilot, then widen

We start with one channel or one workflow so you can see it live—then expand coverage with your team, not a 40-page rollout plan.

06

We stay after launch

Flows drift. Products change. We keep tuning the assistant and the automations as your operation does.
